name: Primaclaw
ability: Primal Mimicry (its own: its Water-type moves get the same-type bonus too) / Strong Jaw / Intimidate (hidden)
look: a tiny black spiky crab on long white legs holding up two enormous claws: Groudon's head and Kyogre's head, borrowed from Mega Showdown's models
entry: Its two claws imitate the ancient titans of land and sea so perfectly that the sight of a Primaclaw on the shore once sent whole villages fleeing inland. The crab itself is tiny, hiding between the two great heads.
how: Evolve Crabgron at level 50. It learns Headlong Rush when it evolves.
